questions.question: Retrieve the name of each customer along with their account type.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Customer.Name, Account.AccountType FROM Customer JOIN Account ON Customer.ID = Account.CustomerID;

questions.question: Retrieve branch names along with the total number of accounts managed by each branch.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Branch.Name, COUNT(Account.ID) FROM Branch JOIN Account ON Branch.ID = Account.BranchID GROUP BY Branch.ID;

questions.question: Retrieve names of customers who have taken at least one loan with an interest rate greater than 8%.
questions.answer_key: SELECT DISTINCT Customer.Name FROM Customer JOIN Loan ON Customer.ID = Loan.CustomerID WHERE Loan.InterestRate > 8;

questions.question: Retrieve names of customers who have more than two accounts.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Customer.Name FROM Customer JOIN Account ON Customer.ID = Account.CustomerID GROUP BY Customer.ID HAVING COUNT(Account.ID) > 2;

questions.question: Retrieve branch names where the average account balance is greater than 100,000.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Branch.Name FROM Branch JOIN Account ON Branch.ID = Account.BranchID GROUP BY Branch.ID HAVING AVG(Account.Balance) > 100000;

questions.question: Retrieve account IDs where the total withdrawal amount exceeds the total deposit amount.
questions.answer_key: SELECT AccountID FROM 'Transaction' GROUP BY AccountID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN TransactionType = 'Withdrawal' THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN TransactionType = 'Deposit' THEN Amount ELSE 0 END);

questions.question: Retrieve names of customers whose total loan amount is greater than their total account balance.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Name FROM Customer WHERE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Amount),0) FROM Loan WHERE Loan.CustomerID = Customer.ID) > (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Balance),0) FROM Account WHERE Account.CustomerID = Customer.ID);

questions.question: Retrieve the loan ID where the total payments made are less than 40% of the loan amount.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Loan.ID FROM Loan LEFT JOIN LoanPayment ON Loan.ID = LoanPayment.LoanID GROUP BY Loan.ID HAVING COALESCE(SUM(LoanPayment.PaymentAmount),0) < 0.4 * Loan.Amount;

questions.question: Retrieve the employee name and branch name of the highest paid employee in each branch.
questions.answer_key: SELECT E.Name, B.Name FROM Employee E JOIN Branch B ON E.BranchID = B.ID WHERE E.Salary = (SELECT MAX(Salary) FROM Employee WHERE BranchID = E.BranchID);

questions.question: Retrieve the name of the customer who has the second highest total transaction amount across all their accounts.
questions.answer_key: SELECT Customer.Name FROM Customer JOIN Account ON Customer.ID = Account.CustomerID JOIN 'Transaction' ON Account.ID = 'Transaction'.AccountID GROUP BY Customer.ID ORDER BY SUM('Transaction'.Amount) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
